thread:
ana: Quick heads-up — SiWave (pilot) is blocked on marketplace onboarding. They need a private deployment for data residency but the marketplace package we proposed publishes a public image. Can we do an architecture sign-off + path to a private image push? @lee can you take point and loop in the HW partner?

lee: On it. Can someone drop the customer's infra doc/link? I want to validate the host specs before the arch review.

tess: I have the SOW and timeline. If we don't unblock by EOD Mon their canary slips a week. Customer is pushing for a soft-go-live in two weeks.

rahul: Quick eng constraints: model build uses 8-bit quant + a couple of fused kernels (custom CUDA ops). Private/on-prem package must match CUDA/cuDNN or we'll need to fall back to slower kernels. Need to confirm GPU type (A10/A30 vs older gen).

lee: @rahul what minimum driver/CUDA do we need? I'll surface that to the partner.

rahul: Minimum is CUDA 11.8 and NVIDIA driver 525+. Recommend GPU mem >=32GB; host RAM >=64GB for stable KV cache. If they have older drivers we can provide CPU-fallback with ~3x latency — needs to be explicit in the SOW.

ops: Networking checklist (high level): outbound to S3 endpoints, outbound to api.redwood.ai:443, outbound to metrics.redwood.ai:443. Inbound only via customer bastion/VPN. Example snippet: 
```yaml
firewall:
  - outbound: 443 # api.redwood.ai
  - outbound: 9000 # s3/minio
  - inbound: 22 # bastion access only
```

lee: I'll draft a targeted checklist (device drivers, ports, image registry auth, kernel modules) and schedule a 30m architecture review with SiWave + HW partner tomorrow 09:30 PST. @sam from eng-runtime pls join.

sam: I'll join. FYI: if they can't upgrade drivers we can enable quant fallback path (works but perf hit). I'll prepare perf delta numbers and a small runbook for fallback config.

priority-bot: Ticket created: INC-2207 — SiWave marketplace/private-image escalation. Owner: ana. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2207 :white_check_mark:

ana: Thanks, everyone. Action items: lee — checklist + arch invite; sam — perf delta + runbook; rahul — confirm driver & mem reqs with partner; ops — add firewall snippet to implementation guide. I'll consolidate notes and post to the partnerships channel and the SI's Slack thread.

lee: Got it. I'll post the checklist doc (confluence link) after the call and ping the HW partner.

rahul: Also adding note: if HW partner requires specific kernel modules, we need to sign off security review — flagging @ops for compliance steps.

ops: Noted. I'll add compliance checklist to the ticket and schedule the security review slot.

tess: Keeping customer updated. Will confirm their internal maintenance window.

lee: Thanks all. See you on the call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
